args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter — Freight pricing this quarter (summary)
args.body:
Sources: newsletter "Freight pricing this quarter" (newsletter@saltmarsh.example) → article https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/freight → companion https://insights.saltmarsh.example/freight/companion

• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady — a widening gap between spot and contracted pricing.
• Fuel surcharges are now indexed to weekly diesel prices, so surcharge costs will fluctuate more frequently rather than being set quarterly.
• Companion piece: shippers that split volume across three carriers paid the least, suggesting multi-carrier tendering beats single-carrier consolidation this quarter.

Note: the newsletter offered a "team licence" URL (?team=<company>&seat=<name>) for the companion piece, but the companion was readable without it, so no licence credentials were asserted on Northwind's behalf.
